method: Individual source review, decoded PE inspection with rizin and managed IL disassembly, atomscan --mode slow --follow=none, cleave facts. Samples were never executed. Distinct trait IDs are counted once across decoded layers. Archive convictions were preserved.
extract_layout: Debian data.tar was extracted directly under extract/<id>/usr; markers are beside the actual extracted members, not synthetic archive !! paths or the trait repository.
corrections: Unsigned high-entropy single-import .NET properties establish no loader or obfuscation. Removed the hostile duplicate; existing metadata/binary/code/entropy::unsigned-high-entropy-single-import-dotnet remains.

Moved Rubeus harvesting to credential-access/memory. Its /ptt option is a neutral auth/session trait, not a system credential dump.

Updated the exact reflective-loader consumer. The webroot-loot parent selector retains migrated attack composites explicitly; ticket help and /ptt alone no longer stand in for credential acquisition. The setuid-backdoor system selector is Unix ELF/Mach-O only and cannot select the migrated Windows-only rules. Ancestor credential-access selectors still reach the moved objectives. No consumers reference the retired entropy/service-dumper IDs.
